fields.name: AnimationRequested
fields.evidence: Creators bg3.exe+0x1922120 (deferred add) and bg3.exe+0xDD4930 (immediate add) zero offsets 0-1 with one 2-byte store. The filler is ecl::legacy::item::DoorClosedSystem (factory bg3.exe+0x726860, update thunk bg3.exe+0x758100 -> bg3.exe+0x1921780 -> bg3.exe+0x1921910; the Toolkit names the last one ProcessAnimationsRequests, EoCClient.dll+0x9D57D0, same statements). Every tick, per door: if this byte is 0, or the door is in the entity set at +0x60 of eoc::animation::DoorEventCachingSingletonComponent (its animation events were re-cached), the function stores the word 1 at +0 (this byte 1, AnimationFinished 0), zeroes the float at +4 and adds eoc::item::ISDoorClosedAnimationRequestOneFrameComponent. Probe: always 1 on all 5 client and 5 server instances.

fields.name: AnimationFinished
fields.evidence: Same function: while this byte is 0 the timer at +4 is checked; at 10.0 <= timer the byte is set to 1 (bg3.exe+0x1921910: '*(ptr + 1) = 1') and eoc::item::ISDoorClosedAnimationFinishedOneFrameComponent is added to the door. Reset to 0 by the word store of a new request. Probe: always 1 (doors closed long before the capture).

fields.name: _Pad2
fields.evidence: Never written by the creators or the system (2-byte store at 0, 4-byte store at 4); probe shows garbage here on the client (91 32 / ff ff) and zeros on the server - alignment padding before the float.

fields.name: AnimationTimer
fields.evidence: Same function: while AnimationRequested is 1 and AnimationFinished is 0, the frame time (ls::GameTime+8) is added every tick, and the sum is compared with 10.0 - a timeout after which the closing animation counts as finished; zeroed on a new request. Probe: client always 0x412000D9 = 10.00002, server 10.015 / 10.018 - the value at which the accumulation stopped, with a larger overshoot on the coarser server tick, exactly as this code produces.

open_questions: The probed doors all finished by the 10 s timeout. Whether another system sets AnimationFinished earlier when the animation really ends (the flags are public to the animation systems through the AnimationFinished one-frame component) was not looked for.
The server uses the same component through esv::legacy::item::DoorClosedSystem (factory bg3.exe+0x2357D20); its update was not opened, the server probe values fit the same logic.
eoc::item::ISDoorOpenedComponent has the same layout: see layouts/equipment/eoc.item.ISDoorOpenedComponent.json.
